description: React component `TopKeyView` that displays top keys either as a table or a chart, with functionality to fetch detailed key info on click and display in a modal.

methods.name: toggleTagsExpansion
methods.description: Toggles the expansion state for tags of a specific API key.

methods.name: handleKeyClick
methods.description: Fetches detailed info for a specific key and opens a modal to display it.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Closes the modal and resets related state.

methods.name: handleOutsideClick
methods.description: Closes modal if clicking outside the modal content.
